verses.mystical_translation: A new hand takes rule and sets firm boundaries — strength formed at the frontier of kinship.
He secures the storied places, keeping hold of heritage and the gains of the prior reign.
Accompanied by YHWH, his steps echo David's opening paths; fidelity resists foreign shrines.
He turns toward the ancestral God and tracks the covenant’s instructions rather than common conduct.
Because YHWH steadies the rule, the realm offers gifts; worldly abundance attends legitimate rule.
His heart rises along YHWH’s road; the household clears the altars and the wooden poles of older rites.
He sends forth leaders as teachers, scattering instruction like seed into the towns.
Canonical voices and temple keepers go together; names form the chorus that will read the law aloud.
The law-book travels the roads; a written presence forms the people’s conscience.
Awe of YHWH spreads beyond borders; peace follows where awe is found.
Gifts arrive from neighbors; pastoral tribute marks political ties in counted herds.
Growth shows in stone and grain — monuments to provision and defense.
State tasks multiply; valor gathers in the city, a concentrated force of muscle and loyalty.
A register names captains and their vast bands — a people counted as war’s measure.
Another column follows in ordered ranks; numbers stand like banners.
A volunteer offers himself to YHWH; devotion and arms are counted side by side.
From Benjamin a spearhead of archers and shields; a tribe named as armament.
Another column stands ready — numbers arranged to meet the drum of battle.
They serve at the sovereign’s hand; other guardians are posted as the king assigned them across the land.

contemplative_note: A king who strengthens realm and worship: consider how public power and devotion shape common life.
